source.version: main snapshot reviewed 2026-07-13; no tagged release

capabilities.title: Guide UI implementation and review with detailed animation, interaction, and visual-polish rules
capabilities.reason: The Company Map links the source, but Nexus has not yet reconciled its complete rule set against the authoritative Nexus taste contract.

capabilities.title: Decide whether an interaction should animate based on frequency and purpose before choosing motion
capabilities.reason: Nexus has motion guidance but lacks focused proof that this complete frequency-and-purpose framework is encoded and enforced.

capabilities.title: Review animations against explicit easing, duration, origin, physicality, accessibility, and performance rules
capabilities.reason: No source-specific review command or acceptance proof was added in this tranche.

capabilities.title: Recon and audit all interactive UI across eight motion categories with evidence-backed severity
capabilities.reason: A real Nexus audit must confirm findings against current files and interaction frequency before claiming this capability.

capabilities.title: Pause after vetted findings, then write self-contained implementation plans only for selected items without touching source code
capabilities.reason: This review-gated planning pattern is compatible with Nexus, but no dedicated animation-plan workflow was implemented.

capabilities.title: Map vague motion descriptions to precise animation terms for better design and AI instructions
capabilities.reason: Nexus does not yet expose or validate this glossary as a project-owned capability.

capabilities.title: Translate responsive, physical, interruptible, velocity-aware, and reduced-motion interaction principles to web interfaces
capabilities.reason: Useful rules require selective review against Nexus product identity, accessibility, performance, and existing motion conventions.

capabilities.title: Install the full Markdown skill collection through the cross-host skills CLI
capabilities.reason: Nexus records the Codex-compatible path but intentionally does not bulk-install external skill packs.
